But he is too fond of those overbore Dennia quad guns, because they give the ''Falcon'' surprise punch.|translated=1|Jowdrrl and Chewbacca in 16 ABY|<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>}}
'''Auto-tracking fire controllers''' were supplements for [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] that could be installed in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. They allowed for fully automated firing rather than manual operation of the guns. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jowdrrl]] installed some in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />
